summaryZh: Joseph 研究组研究蛋白质合成与翻译机制，以及脑内的翻译调控。它开发生化、生物物理和遗传学工具研究翻译步骤，并将脆性X综合征作为理解脑内翻译调控的切入点。
researchQuestions: 突触处的蛋白质合成如何受到调控？
FMRP 调控翻译的机制是什么？
流感病毒如何劫持宿主细胞的蛋白质合成机器，以主要翻译病毒 mRNA？

evidence.quote: We have developed powerful biochemical, biophysical and genetic tools to study specific steps in translation.
we are studying Fragile X Syndrome (FXS)
It is not clear how protein synthesis is regulated at the synapse. As a step towards understanding the role of translational control in the brain we are studying Fragile X Syndrome (FXS)
We are interested in dissecting the mechanism of translational control by FMRP.
We are interested in understanding how influenza virus is able to hijack the protein synthesis machinery of the host cell to predominantly translate viral mRNAs.
